r: Have you seen my brother Andor around here? Looks somewhat like me.
Do you by any chance have some spare wood to make fences out of?
I'm $playername, running up and down Blackwater mountain for errands.

hadracor_accept_1.m: You would? Sure, you have a try.

hadracor_accept_1_1.m: I noticed that some of the wasps are larger than the other ones, and the other wasps tend to follow the larger ones around.

hadracor_accept_2.m: If you could kill at least five of those giant ones and bring me back their wings as proof, I would be very grateful.
r: Sure, I will be back with those giant wasp wings for you.
On second thought, I better stay out of this.

hadracor_accept_3.m: Good, hurry back once you are done.

hadracor_andor_1.m: Looks like you eh? No, I would have remembered.

hadracor_complete_1.m: Hello again. Thank you for your help with those wasps earlier.

hadracor_complete_2.m: As a token of our appreciation, we are willing to trade some of our equipment with you if you want.

hadracor_complete_3.m: It's not much, but we do have some really sharp axes that you might be interested in.
r: OK, let me see what you have.
Do you by any chance have some spare wood to make fences out of?
No, thanks. I'm too busy running up and down Blackwater mountain.

hadracor_decline_1.m: I will pretend I didn't hear that.

hadracor_decline_2.m: Fine, I guess we can find someone else to help us get revenge on them.

hadracor_fence_1.m: Oh we do have a lot of wood indeed. However, all of this is very brittle and can only be used as firewood.
r: Then, willy-nilly, I will explain to Tunlon that I was unsuccessful. He may even want his 200 gold pieces back.

hadracor_fence_1c.m: I like to sit here and look at the mountains and what's moving there. It's very relaxing after our hard work.
r: Yes, the mountains are very beautiful - from a distance.

hadracor_fence_2.m: I saw you a few times in the forest over there coming from the mountains. Do you go there often?
r: Well, I try to avoid it. The route past Stoutford and Prim is long and arduous.

hadracor_fence_3.m: I like to believe that. Look, I told my men to cut down some trees for you. You can now take a shortcut.

hadracor_fence_4.m: The passage is over there, a bit to the east from here.

hadracor_fence_5.m: We were happy to do this for you. Now calm down.

hadracor_gaveitems_1.m: Well done my friend. Thank you for getting revenge on those things.

hadracor_story_1.m: This is the encampment that we woodcutters set up while working on the trees here for the past few days.
r: What have you been working on?
I noticed a lot of tree stumps around here.

hadracor_story_10.m: However, I bet that whatever plans the nobles of Feygard have for these lands, they surely don't include these nasty wasps still being around.

hadracor_story_11.m: See this scratch here? And this abscess? Yep, those wasps.

hadracor_story_12.m: I would love to get revenge on those wasps. We, we aren't good enough fighters to take on those wasps, they are really too quick for us.
r: Tough luck, you seem like a bunch of weaklings anyway.
I could try to take on those wasps for you if you want.
Just a couple of wasps? That's no problem for me. I'll kill them for you.

hadracor_story_2.m: Our orders were to cut down all trees south of the Feygard bridge and north of this here road to Carn Tower.

hadracor_story_3.m: I guess the nobles of Feygard have some plans for these lands.

hadracor_story_4.m: We, we just cut down them trees. No questions asked.

hadracor_story_5.m: However, this time we encountered some trouble.

hadracor_story_6.m: You see, there were these really nasty wasps in that forest we cut down.

hadracor_story_7.m: Nothing like we've seen before, and I'll tell you, we have seen a lot of wildlife in our days.

hadracor_story_8.m: They almost got the best of us, and we were almost ready to quit it. But a job is a job and we need to get paid by Feygard for this job.

hadracor_story_9.m: So we went ahead and finished all of them trees, trying to evade the wasps as much as we could.

hadracor_wantsitems_1.m: Hello again. Did you kill those wasps for us?
r: Could you tell me your story again?
What was I supposed to do again?
Not yet, but I am working on it.
Yes, I killed six of them.
Yes, I killed five of them.
No, but I wanted to ask if you have some spare wood to make fences out of.
No, I'm too busy running up and down Blackwater mountain.

hadracor_wantsitems_2.m: Wow, you actually killed those things?

hadracor_wantsitems_3.m: Wow, you actually killed six of those things? I thought there were only five, so I guess I should be even more grateful. Here, take these gloves as thanks.

hadracor.10: On the road to Carn Tower, west of the Crossroads guardhouse, I met a group of woodcutters led by Hadracor. Hadracor wants me to help him get revenge on some wasps that were attacking them while they were cutting down the forest. To help them get revenge, I should look for giant wasps near their encampment and bring him at least five giant wasp wings.
hadracor.20: I have brought five giant wasp wings to Hadracor.
hadracor.21: I have brought six giant wasp wings to Hadracor. For helping him, he gave me a pair of gloves.
hadracor.30: Hadracor thanked me for helping him and the other woodcutters get revenge on the wasps. In return, he offered me to trade for some of his items.

tunlon_fence.10: I found Tunlon, a sheep farmer, on the hill next to Crossglen. He asked me to help him get some wood for new fences. Since Crossglen doesn't have a lumberjack, I should go to Fallhaven and ask there.
tunlon_fence.12: Tunlon got furious when he saw that I killed his sheep.
tunlon_fence.20: I talked to Fallhaven's woodcutter. He told me that he had done a lot of work lately and therefore can't get any more wood for me. However, I should ask the woodcutters near Crossroads Guardhouse if they can help me.
tunlon_fence.30: The woodcutters told me that they have a lot of wood after clearing out the field around them, however all they have is firewood. Apparently this is not suitable for making fences. I should explain this to Tunlon.
tunlon_fence.32: Hadracor opened up a passage to the south, so I wouldn't have to take the long way up to Tunlon any more.
tunlon_fence.40: I talked to Tunlon again and he told me to talk to his brother Tinlyn if he knew any person who could help me out.
tunlon_fence.100: Tinlyn was glad to meet me. He said that Loneford had a woodcutter who could maybe help me out.
tunlon_fence.110: Tinlyn wasn't really happy to see me. However, he told me to go to Loneford.
tunlon_fence.150: In Loneford, I met a villager who told me he had some spare fences made. I should bring them to Tunlon.
tunlon_fence.200: Tunlon took a close look at the fences I brought him, but he didn't like them a lot. The fence posts were too short he said. I should go back and ask for taller ones.
tunlon_fence.210: The woodcutter in Loneford however said he couldn't make any fences, as he just cuts the wood. He recommended giving Brimhaven's woodcutter a visit, as he thinks that he can do some basic woodwork.
tunlon_fence.220: I gave the woodcutter in Brimhaven a visit and he told me to bring some wood, so the craftsman can make fences out of it. Loneford's woodcutter should have plenty, so I should go back and ask him for wood.
tunlon_fence.230: I got a pile of wood for the fences.
tunlon_fence.235: I gave the wood to the woodcraftsman in Brimhaven.
tunlon_fence.240: Brimhaven's wood craftsman sold me some nice looking fences.
tunlon_fence.250: Tunlon was happy to see the fences I brought him. These should be just fine, he said.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
